sox_ng wiki - Forks

Forks

This is a staging post for interesting work in the hundreds of forks of SoX.

When a fork's interesting commits have been added to the issues, its line is deleted from here.

Root forks

Sourceforge

The 184 commits by Mans Rullgard on the master branch since sox-14.4.2 are such a hotchpotch of new work, bug fixes, bug "fixes" that don't fix the bug they meant to, bug "fixes" that fix non-bugs and change the way it behaves, code refactorization and reformatting, build system rewrites and new bugs, some of which make it fail CVEs that sox-14.4.2 passed, that it can now be considered to be the most extensive and well-furnished fork of sox-14.4.2.

GitHub

Chris Bagwell

Forked from 3 commits after 14.4.2 with 47 forks: * mansr/sox 67 commits ahead: DSD/DSF/WSD, ID3, sdm, msvc fixes * damien78/sox Build fixes for WIN32; lsx FIFO growth optimization; add 64bit sample to 8x1bit sample SDM conversion * hyphop/sox Add DSD output * ohshitgorillas/sox Increase limits * pretony/sox Add streaming support to DSD * simonefil/sox MacOS compatibility fixes

dmkrepo/libsox

Forked from 5 commits after sox.sf.net 14.4.2) with Mac-specific fixes for Visual Studio

janstary/sox

Forked from sox.sf.net commit 507b669 (the one after 42b355) with 2 branches: * build: a new configure not based on autoconf (much faster!) * libsox: a proper manual page instead of doxygen

Packages using libsox

Apart from appreciating the compliments made, they could also be useful for testing libsox, ensuring they link and work OK with a new version: * lzaf/sox uses libsox to convert/filter sound files calling it from go * vitronic/berry-libsox Berry bindings for libSoX * vitronic/lua-libsox Lua bindings for libSoX
